Create a 10-second Manim scene where an input token fans out to three feature boxes. Use LaggedStart to reveal the arrows and AnimationGroup to light up the boxes together at the end.

from manim import *

class LaggedStartAttentionFanout(Scene):
    def construct(self):
        title = Text("Animation Composition for Staged Reveal", font_size=34).to_edge(UP)
        token = RoundedRectangle(corner_radius=0.1, width=1.6, height=0.75, color=BLUE_D, fill_opacity=0.16).shift(LEFT * 4)
        token_label = Text("token", font_size=22, color=BLUE_D).move_to(token)
        boxes = VGroup(*[
            VGroup(
                RoundedRectangle(corner_radius=0.1, width=1.8, height=0.75, color=TEAL_D, fill_opacity=0.12),
                Text(label, font_size=21, color=TEAL_D),
            )
            for label in ["shape", "color", "motion"]
        ]).arrange(DOWN, buff=0.7).shift(RIGHT * 2.6)
        for group in boxes:
            group[1].move_to(group[0])
        arrows = VGroup(*[Arrow(token.get_right(), group[0].get_left(), buff=0.15, color=GRAY_B) for group in boxes])
        caption = Text("LaggedStart staggers the reveal, then AnimationGroup synchronizes emphasis.", font_size=24, color=GRAY_D).to_edge(DOWN)

        self.play(FadeIn(title), FadeIn(token), FadeIn(token_label), run_time=2)
        self.play(LaggedStart(*[GrowArrow(arrow) for arrow in arrows], lag_ratio=0.18), LaggedStart(*[FadeIn(group) for group in boxes], lag_ratio=0.18), run_time=4)
        self.play(AnimationGroup(*[group[0].animate.set_fill(YELLOW_D, opacity=0.28) for group in boxes], lag_ratio=0.0), FadeIn(caption), run_time=2)
        self.wait(2)

from manim import *

        title = Text('Sigmoid Saturates In The Tails', font_size=29).to_edge(UP)
        axes = Axes(x_range=[-5, 5, 2], y_range=[0, 1.1, 0.5], x_length=7.0, y_length=4.1, tips=False).shift(UP * 0.35)
        curve = axes.plot(lambda x: 1 / (1 + np.exp(-x)), x_range=[-5, 5], color=BLUE_D)
        left_dot = Dot(axes.c2p(-4, 0.018), color=RED_D, radius=0.07)
        center_dot = Dot(axes.c2p(0, 0.5), color=GREEN_D, radius=0.07)
        right_dot = Dot(axes.c2p(4, 0.982), color=RED_D, radius=0.07)
        labels = VGroup(Text('tiny gradient', font_size=18, color=RED_D).next_to(left_dot, LEFT, buff=0.12), Text('largest gradient', font_size=18, color=GREEN_D).next_to(center_dot, UR, buff=0.12), Text('tiny gradient', font_size=18, color=RED_D).next_to(right_dot, RIGHT, buff=0.12))
        bars = VGroup(Rectangle(width=0.55, height=0.28, color=RED_D, fill_color=RED_D, fill_opacity=0.45), Rectangle(width=0.55, height=1.35, color=GREEN_D, fill_color=GREEN_D, fill_opacity=0.45), Rectangle(width=0.55, height=0.28, color=RED_D, fill_color=RED_D, fill_opacity=0.45)).arrange(RIGHT, buff=1.25, aligned_edge=DOWN).move_to(DOWN * 2.3)
        bar_title = Text('gradient size', font_size=18, color=WHITE).next_to(bars, UP, buff=0.14)
        connectors = VGroup(Line(left_dot.get_bottom(), bars[0].get_top(), color=GRAY_B), Line(center_dot.get_bottom(), bars[1].get_top(), color=GRAY_B), Line(right_dot.get_bottom(), bars[2].get_top(), color=GRAY_B))

        self.play(FadeIn(title), Create(axes), Create(curve), run_time=2.1)
        self.play(FadeIn(left_dot), FadeIn(center_dot), FadeIn(right_dot), FadeIn(labels), run_time=1.8)
        self.play(Create(connectors), LaggedStart(*[GrowFromEdge(bar, DOWN) for bar in bars], lag_ratio=0.16), FadeIn(bar_title), run_time=2.1)
        self.play(FadeIn(caption_group), Indicate(bars[1], color=YELLOW_A), run_time=1.5)

from manim import *

class AtomicRadiusTrend(Scene):
    def construct(self):
        title = Text("Atomic Radius Across Period 2", font_size=34).to_edge(UP)
        symbols = ["Li", "Be", "B", "C", "N", "O", "F", "Ne"]
        radii = [0.72, 0.65, 0.58, 0.52, 0.47, 0.43, 0.39, 0.35]
        circles = VGroup()
        for symbol, radius in zip(symbols, radii):
            circle = Circle(radius=radius, color=BLUE_D, fill_color=BLUE_B, fill_opacity=0.18)
            label = Text(symbol, font_size=22).move_to(circle)
            group = VGroup(circle, label)
            circles.add(group)
        circles.arrange(RIGHT, buff=0.38).shift(UP * 0.4)
        trend_arrow = Arrow(circles[0].get_bottom() + DOWN * 0.5, circles[-1].get_bottom() + DOWN * 0.5, color=YELLOW_D, buff=0)
        trend_text = Text("Radius decreases", font_size=24, color=YELLOW_D).next_to(trend_arrow, DOWN)
        caption = VGroup(
            Text("Across a period, effective nuclear charge increases.", font_size=24),
            Text("Electrons are pulled closer to the nucleus.", font_size=22, color=GRAY_C),
        ).arrange(DOWN, buff=0.18).to_edge(DOWN)
        self.play(FadeIn(title), LaggedStart(*[FadeIn(group) for group in circles], lag_ratio=0.12), run_time=5)
        self.play(GrowArrow(trend_arrow), FadeIn(trend_text), run_time=3)
        self.play(LaggedStart(*[Indicate(group[0], color=TEAL_A) for group in circles], lag_ratio=0.15), run_time=5)
        self.play(FadeIn(caption), run_time=3)
        self.wait(2)

Create a 50-second Manim explainer for enzyme catalysis. Show an uncatalyzed reaction profile, then a lower catalyzed profile, highlight the activation-energy difference, and connect the plot to reactant and product cartoons.

from manim import *

class EnzymeCatalysisProfile(Scene):
    def construct(self):
        title = Text("Why Catalysts Speed Reactions", font_size=40).to_edge(UP)
        axes = Axes(
            x_range=[0, 10, 2],
            y_range=[0, 6, 1],
            x_length=8,
            y_length=4.5,
            axis_config={"include_numbers": False},
            tips=False,
        ).shift(DOWN * 0.2)
        axis_labels = VGroup(
            Text("reaction progress", font_size=24).next_to(axes, DOWN),
            Text("energy", font_size=24).rotate(PI / 2).next_to(axes, LEFT),
        )
        uncatalyzed = axes.plot(lambda x: 0.35 + 4.6 * np.exp(-((x - 4.4) ** 2) / 2.2) + 0.06 * x, color=RED_D)
        catalyzed = axes.plot(lambda x: 0.35 + 2.4 * np.exp(-((x - 4.8) ** 2) / 2.4) + 0.06 * x, color=GREEN_D)
        reactant = VGroup(Circle(radius=0.22, color=BLUE, fill_opacity=0.25), Circle(radius=0.22, color=BLUE, fill_opacity=0.25).shift(RIGHT * 0.45)).arrange(RIGHT, buff=0.1).shift(LEFT * 5.0 + DOWN * 1.8)
        product = VGroup(Circle(radius=0.22, color=PURPLE, fill_opacity=0.25), Circle(radius=0.22, color=PURPLE, fill_opacity=0.25).shift(UP * 0.35)).shift(RIGHT * 5.0 + DOWN * 1.8)
        arrow = Arrow(reactant.get_right(), product.get_left(), buff=0.25, color=GRAY_B)
        reactant_label = Text("reactants", font_size=22).next_to(reactant, DOWN)
        product_label = Text("products", font_size=22).next_to(product, DOWN)

        unc_peak = axes.c2p(4.4, 5.0)
        cat_peak = axes.c2p(4.8, 2.9)
        start_level = axes.c2p(1.0, 0.55)
        unc_barrier = DoubleArrow(start_level, unc_peak, color=RED_D, buff=0.0, stroke_width=5)
        cat_barrier = DoubleArrow(start_level + RIGHT * 0.5, cat_peak, color=GREEN_D, buff=0.0, stroke_width=5)
        unc_label = Text("uncatalyzed", font_size=24, color=RED_D).next_to(uncatalyzed, UP)
        cat_label = Text("catalyzed", font_size=24, color=GREEN_D).next_to(catalyzed, DOWN)
        barrier_note = Text("Lower activation energy means more successful crossings", font_size=28, color=GRAY_D).to_edge(DOWN)
        enzyme_box = RoundedRectangle(corner_radius=0.12, width=2.2, height=0.8, color=GREEN_D, fill_opacity=0.15).shift(DOWN * 2.9)
        enzyme_text = Text("enzyme offers an easier path", font_size=22, color=GREEN_D).move_to(enzyme_box)

        self.play(FadeIn(title), Create(axes), FadeIn(axis_labels), run_time=4)
        self.play(FadeIn(reactant), FadeIn(product), GrowArrow(arrow), FadeIn(reactant_label), FadeIn(product_label), run_time=4)
        self.play(Create(uncatalyzed), FadeIn(unc_label), run_time=5)
        self.wait(1)
        self.play(Create(unc_barrier), run_time=3)
        self.wait(1)
        self.play(Create(catalyzed), FadeIn(cat_label), run_time=5)
        self.play(Create(cat_barrier), run_time=3)
        self.play(FadeIn(enzyme_box), FadeIn(enzyme_text), run_time=3)
        self.play(FadeIn(barrier_note), run_time=3)
        self.wait(3)

Create a 30-second Manim explainer that combines a titration curve, a moving equivalence tracker, and a small summary table. Highlight the acidic, rapid-change, and basic regions as separate beats instead of just showing the final chart.

from manim import *

class TitrationTableTrackerStory(Scene):
    def construct(self):
        title = Text("Reading a Titration Curve in Stages", font_size=36).to_edge(UP)
        axes = Axes(x_range=[0, 10, 1], y_range=[0, 14, 2], x_length=7.2, y_length=4.6, tips=False).shift(LEFT * 1.7 + DOWN * 0.2)
        curve = axes.plot(lambda x: 7 + 3.1 * np.tanh((x - 5.0) * 1.2) + 0.12 * (x - 5.0), x_range=[0.6, 9.4], color=BLUE_D)
        tracker = ValueTracker(2.0)
        probe = always_redraw(lambda: Dot(axes.i2gp(tracker.get_value(), curve), color=YELLOW, radius=0.08))
        probe_line = always_redraw(lambda: DashedLine(axes.c2p(tracker.get_value(), 0), probe.get_center(), color=YELLOW_D, stroke_width=3))
        eq_line = DashedLine(axes.c2p(5, 0), axes.c2p(5, 14), color=RED_D, stroke_width=4)
        eq_label = Text("equivalence", font_size=22, color=RED_D).next_to(eq_line, UP)
        table = MathTable([["region", "shape"], ["acidic", "slow rise"], ["transition", "steep jump"], ["basic", "plateau"]], include_outer_lines=True).scale(0.42).to_edge(RIGHT).shift(DOWN * 0.2)
        row_a = SurroundingRectangle(table.get_rows()[1], color=BLUE_D, buff=0.05)
        row_b = SurroundingRectangle(table.get_rows()[2], color=YELLOW_D, buff=0.05)
        row_c = SurroundingRectangle(table.get_rows()[3], color=GREEN_D, buff=0.05)
        caption_a = Text("Early on, the pH moves slowly while acid still dominates.", font_size=24, color=GRAY_D).to_edge(DOWN)
        caption_b = Text("Near equivalence, a small volume change produces a large pH jump.", font_size=24, color=GRAY_D).to_edge(DOWN)
        caption_c = Text("After the jump, extra base keeps the curve on its upper plateau.", font_size=24, color=GRAY_D).to_edge(DOWN)

        self.play(FadeIn(title), Create(axes), Create(curve), FadeIn(table), run_time=4)
        self.play(FadeIn(probe), Create(probe_line), Create(row_a), FadeIn(caption_a), run_time=4)
        self.play(tracker.animate.set_value(4.7), run_time=5)
        self.play(Create(eq_line), FadeIn(eq_label), ReplacementTransform(row_a, row_b), ReplacementTransform(caption_a, caption_b), run_time=5)
        self.play(tracker.animate.set_value(5.4), run_time=4)
        self.play(tracker.animate.set_value(8.5), ReplacementTransform(row_b, row_c), ReplacementTransform(caption_b, caption_c), run_time=5)
        self.wait(2)

Create a 30-second Manim scene that explains a damped oscillator with a spring-mass sketch on one side and a phase portrait on the other. Use a ValueTracker, a traced phase path, and staged captions so the shrinking amplitude is visually obvious.

from manim import *

class DampedOscillatorPhasePortraitStory(Scene):
    def construct(self):
        def displacement(t):
            return 1.7 * np.exp(-0.14 * t) * np.cos(2.6 * t)

        def velocity(t):
            return -1.7 * np.exp(-0.14 * t) * (0.14 * np.cos(2.6 * t) + 2.6 * np.sin(2.6 * t))

        title = Text("Damping Shrinks the Oscillator State", font_size=34).to_edge(UP)
        wall = Rectangle(width=0.35, height=2.6, color=GRAY_D, fill_color=GRAY_D, fill_opacity=0.5).move_to(LEFT * 5.6)
        baseline = Line(LEFT * 5.4 + DOWN * 1.55, LEFT * 0.8 + DOWN * 1.55, color=GRAY_C)
        tracker = ValueTracker(0.0)
        mass = always_redraw(lambda: RoundedRectangle(corner_radius=0.1, width=1.05, height=0.82, color=BLUE_D, fill_color=BLUE_E, fill_opacity=0.25).move_to(np.array([-2.2 + displacement(tracker.get_value()), 0.0, 0.0])))
        spring = always_redraw(
            lambda: ParametricFunction(
                lambda s: np.array([
                    interpolate(-5.35, mass.get_left()[0], s),
                    0.18 * np.sin(10 * PI * s),
                    0,
                ]),
                t_range=[0, 1],
                color=YELLOW_D,
                stroke_width=4,
            )
        )
        phase_axes = Axes(x_range=[-2.2, 2.2, 1], y_range=[-4.8, 4.8, 2], x_length=4.7, y_length=4.4, tips=False).to_edge(RIGHT).shift(DOWN * 0.1)
        axis_labels = phase_axes.get_axis_labels(Text("x", font_size=22), Text("v", font_size=22))
        phase_dot = always_redraw(lambda: Dot(phase_axes.c2p(displacement(tracker.get_value()), velocity(tracker.get_value())), color=RED_D, radius=0.08))
        phase_trace = TracedPath(phase_dot.get_center, stroke_color=RED_D, stroke_width=4)
        readout = always_redraw(lambda: VGroup(Text("time", font_size=22, color=GRAY_D), DecimalNumber(tracker.get_value(), num_decimal_places=1, font_size=28, color=YELLOW_D)).arrange(RIGHT, buff=0.15).to_corner(UR).shift(DOWN * 0.7))
        caption_a = Text("The mass oscillates, but damping steadily removes amplitude from the motion.", font_size=23, color=GRAY_D).to_edge(DOWN)
        caption_b = Text("The phase portrait turns that motion into a spiral toward the origin.", font_size=23, color=GRAY_D).to_edge(DOWN)
        caption_c = Text("Both views tell the same story: position and velocity decay together over time.", font_size=23, color=GRAY_D).to_edge(DOWN)

        self.add(phase_trace)
        self.play(FadeIn(title), FadeIn(wall), Create(baseline), Create(phase_axes), FadeIn(axis_labels), FadeIn(caption_a), run_time=4)
        self.play(Create(spring), FadeIn(mass), FadeIn(phase_dot), FadeIn(readout), run_time=4)
        self.play(tracker.animate.set_value(4.0), ReplacementTransform(caption_a, caption_b), run_time=6, rate_func=linear)
        self.play(tracker.animate.set_value(8.0), run_time=6, rate_func=linear)
        self.play(tracker.animate.set_value(11.0), ReplacementTransform(caption_b, caption_c), run_time=5, rate_func=linear)
        self.wait(2)

Create a 15-second database scene explaining a lost-update anomaly. Show two transactions reading the same value, computing different updates, and overwriting one another; then contrast it with serialized execution. Make clear that atomic writes alone do not prevent the anomaly.

from manim import *

class LostUpdateAnomaly(Scene):
    def construct(self):
        self.camera.background_color = "#FAFAF8"
        ink = "#222222"
        title = Text("Two valid writes can still lose an update", font_size=37, color=ink).to_edge(UP)
        db = VGroup(
            RoundedRectangle(width=2.2, height=1.0, corner_radius=0.15, color=BLUE_D),
            Text("balance = 10", font_size=25, color=ink),
        ).shift(UP * 1.5)
        t1 = VGroup(Text("T1", font_size=26, color=BLUE_D), Text("read 10 → write 11", font_size=23, color=ink)).arrange(DOWN).shift(LEFT * 3)
        t2 = VGroup(Text("T2", font_size=26, color=ORANGE), Text("read 10 → write 12", font_size=23, color=ink)).arrange(DOWN).shift(RIGHT * 3)
        read_arrows = VGroup(
            Arrow(db.get_left(), t1.get_top(), color=BLUE_D, buff=0.2),
            Arrow(db.get_right(), t2.get_top(), color=ORANGE, buff=0.2),
        )
        final_bad = Text("final = 12   (+1 was lost)", font_size=27, color=RED).shift(DOWN * 1.25)
        serialize = Text("serialize: T1 writes 11, then T2 reads 11 and writes 13", font_size=24, color=GREEN_D).to_edge(DOWN)
        boundary = Text("Atomic writes alone do not prevent a lost update.", font_size=23, color=ink).to_edge(DOWN)

        self.play(FadeIn(title, db, t1, t2), GrowArrow(read_arrows[0]), GrowArrow(read_arrows[1]))
        self.play(Indicate(t1, color=BLUE_D), Indicate(t2, color=ORANGE))
        write1 = Arrow(t1.get_top(), db.get_left(), color=BLUE_D, buff=0.2)
        write2 = Arrow(t2.get_top(), db.get_right(), color=ORANGE, buff=0.2)
        self.play(GrowArrow(write1))
        db11 = Text("balance = 11", font_size=25, color=ink).move_to(db[1])
        self.play(Transform(db[1], db11))
        self.play(GrowArrow(write2))
        db12 = Text("balance = 12", font_size=25, color=ink).move_to(db[1])
        self.play(Transform(db[1], db12), FadeIn(final_bad))
        self.play(ReplacementTransform(final_bad, serialize))
        self.play(ReplacementTransform(serialize, boundary), Circumscribe(db, color=RED))
        self.wait(3)

from manim import *

class NecessarySufficientSets(Scene):
    def construct(self):
        title = Text("Nested sets make necessity and sufficiency visible", font_size=36).to_edge(UP)
        set_b = Circle(radius=2.4, color=BLUE_B, fill_opacity=0.1)
        set_a = Circle(radius=1.15, color=ORANGE, fill_opacity=0.16).shift(LEFT * 0.4)
        label_b = Text("B", font_size=30, color=BLUE_B).next_to(set_b, UR, buff=-0.55)
        label_a = Text("A", font_size=30, color=ORANGE).move_to(set_a.get_top() + DOWN * 0.3)
        inside = Dot(set_a.get_center() + DOWN * 0.35, color=YELLOW)
        only_b = Dot(set_b.get_center() + RIGHT * 1.65, color=TEAL_B)
        sufficient = Text("A is sufficient for B:  A → B", font_size=25, color=ORANGE).to_edge(DOWN)

Create a 12-second operations-research scene explaining a queue bottleneck. Show jobs arriving at a workstation faster than they are completed so the queue grows, then reduce arrivals and let the queue drain. Emphasize that utilization near capacity makes waiting sensitive to variability.

from manim import *

class QueueBottleneck(Scene):
    def construct(self):
        title = Text("When arrivals outpace service, the queue grows", font_size=37).to_edge(UP)
        source = Text("arrivals", font_size=24, color=BLUE_B).shift(LEFT * 5 + UP * 1.5)
        server = VGroup(
            RoundedRectangle(width=2.1, height=1.25, corner_radius=0.15, color=ORANGE),
            Text("workstation", font_size=24),
        ).shift(RIGHT * 2)
        exit_label = Text("completed", font_size=23, color=GREEN).shift(RIGHT * 5 + UP * 1.5)
        queue_slots = VGroup(*[
            Square(side_length=0.62, color=GRAY_B).shift(LEFT * (2.9 - index * 0.72))
            for index in range(5)
        ]).shift(DOWN * 0.1)
        jobs = VGroup(*[
            Circle(radius=0.19, color=BLUE_B, fill_opacity=0.8).move_to(queue_slots[index])
            for index in range(2)
        ])
        rate_caption = Text("arrival rate > service rate", font_size=25, color=RED).to_edge(DOWN)
        calmer = Text("fewer arrivals → the queue can drain", font_size=25, color=GREEN).to_edge(DOWN)
        boundary = Text("Near capacity, variability can create long waits.", font_size=24, color=YELLOW).to_edge(DOWN)

        self.play(Write(title), FadeIn(source, server, exit_label), Create(queue_slots), FadeIn(jobs))
        new_jobs = VGroup(*[
            Circle(radius=0.19, color=BLUE_B, fill_opacity=0.8).move_to(LEFT * 5 + DOWN * (0.2 * index))
            for index in range(3)
        ])
        self.play(FadeIn(rate_caption), LaggedStart(*[
            new_jobs[index].animate.move_to(queue_slots[index + 2]) for index in range(3)
        ], lag_ratio=0.2), run_time=2.5)
        self.add(new_jobs)
        served = jobs[0]
        self.play(served.animate.move_to(server.get_center()), Indicate(server, color=ORANGE))
        self.play(served.animate.move_to(RIGHT * 5), FadeOut(served))
        self.play(ReplacementTransform(rate_caption, calmer))
        remaining = VGroup(jobs[1], *new_jobs)
        self.play(LaggedStart(*[
            job.animate.shift(RIGHT * 0.72) for job in remaining
        ], lag_ratio=0.15))
        self.play(LaggedStart(
            FadeOut(remaining[-1], shift=RIGHT * 3),
            FadeOut(remaining[-2], shift=RIGHT * 3),
            lag_ratio=0.4,
        ), run_time=1.5)
        self.play(ReplacementTransform(calmer, boundary), Circumscribe(queue_slots, color=YELLOW))
        self.wait(2)

from manim import *

        title = Text("Robotics Uses Multiple Coordinate Frames", font_size=34).to_edge(UP)
        world_origin = Dot(LEFT * 3.2 + DOWN * 0.2, color=GRAY_B, radius=0.06)
        world_x = Arrow(world_origin.get_center(), world_origin.get_center() + RIGHT * 1.5, buff=0.0, color=BLUE_D, stroke_width=4)
        world_y = Arrow(world_origin.get_center(), world_origin.get_center() + UP * 1.3, buff=0.0, color=TEAL_D, stroke_width=4)
        world_label = Text("world frame", font_size=22, color=GRAY_D).next_to(world_origin, DOWN, buff=0.18)
        angle = ValueTracker(0.0)
        shift = ValueTracker(0.0)
        robot_origin = always_redraw(lambda: Dot(np.array([0.8 + shift.get_value(), -0.4 + 0.4 * shift.get_value(), 0]), color=YELLOW_D, radius=0.07))
        robot_x = always_redraw(lambda: Arrow(robot_origin.get_center(), robot_origin.get_center() + 1.1 * np.array([np.cos(angle.get_value()), np.sin(angle.get_value()), 0]), buff=0.0, color=ORANGE, stroke_width=4))
        robot_y = always_redraw(lambda: Arrow(robot_origin.get_center(), robot_origin.get_center() + 0.95 * np.array([-np.sin(angle.get_value()), np.cos(angle.get_value()), 0]), buff=0.0, color=GREEN_D, stroke_width=4))
        robot_label = always_redraw(lambda: Text("robot frame", font_size=22, color=YELLOW_D).next_to(robot_origin, DOWN, buff=0.16))
        link = always_redraw(lambda: DashedLine(world_origin.get_center(), robot_origin.get_center(), color=GRAY_C, stroke_width=3))
        caption_a = Text("The world frame stays fixed while the robot moves through it.", font_size=23, color=GRAY_D).to_edge(DOWN)
        caption_b = Text("The robot frame translates and rotates with the robot body.", font_size=23, color=GRAY_D).to_edge(DOWN)
        caption_c = Text("Coordinates depend on which frame you use to describe the same point.", font_size=23, color=GRAY_D).to_edge(DOWN)

        self.play(FadeIn(title), FadeIn(world_origin), GrowArrow(world_x), GrowArrow(world_y), FadeIn(world_label), FadeIn(caption_a), run_time=4)

        self.play(shift.animate.set_value(1.4), angle.animate.set_value(PI / 4), ReplacementTransform(caption_a, caption_b), run_time=6)
        self.play(shift.animate.set_value(2.0), angle.animate.set_value(2 * PI / 3), ReplacementTransform(caption_b, caption_c), run_time=6)

from manim import *

class ProbabilityNumberLineMasses(Scene):
    def construct(self):
        title = Text("Discrete Probability Mass on a Number Line", font_size=32).to_edge(UP)
        line = NumberLine(x_range=[0, 6, 1], include_numbers=True, length=8)
        xs = [1, 2, 4, 5]
        probs = [0.2, 0.35, 0.3, 0.15]
        stems = VGroup()
        labels = VGroup()
        dots = VGroup()
        for x, p in zip(xs, probs):
            base = line.n2p(x)
            top = base + UP * (2.8 * p + 0.3)
            stems.add(Line(base, top, color=BLUE_D, stroke_width=6))
            dots.add(Dot(top, color=YELLOW_D, radius=0.06))
            labels.add(MathTex(f"{p:.2f}", color=YELLOW_D).next_to(top, UP, buff=0.12))
        caption = Text("Each stem height encodes the probability mass at one value.", font_size=24, color=GRAY_D).to_edge(DOWN)

        self.play(FadeIn(title), Create(line), run_time=3)
        self.play(LaggedStart(*[Create(stem) for stem in stems], lag_ratio=0.15), LaggedStart(*[FadeIn(dot) for dot in dots], lag_ratio=0.15), LaggedStart(*[FadeIn(label) for label in labels], lag_ratio=0.15), FadeIn(caption), run_time=4)
